question: Who makes Grove avocado oil
markdown:
Grove avocado oil is made by
Avocado Oil New Zealand Ltd
, operating under the brand name
Grove
, based in the Bay of Plenty region of New Zealand
. The company was started by a collective of local avocado growers over 20 years ago.

Grove Avocado Oil
Production Details
Location:
Te Puna, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand.
Method:
Cold-pressed from Hass avocados using a single-extraction process.
Packaging:
Dark, light-sensitive glass bottles to protect freshness.
